title_en: In the Tirana New Entry 2 complex, 3+1+2 apartment for sale with a spacious veranda!!!
description_en: In Tirana New Entry 2, 3+1+2 apartment for sale with super spacious veranda. The property has a gross area of ​​198 m2, of which the net area is 116 m2 and the area of ​​the veranda is 82.3 m2. It is located on the 7th floor of an 8-story building. It is organized by the distribution corridor, the kitchen corner together with the living room, 3 bedrooms, 2 toilets and veranda. Currently, the construction is in the facade phase. The complex in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life.
